Engine + Editor

Production-minded systems with visible contracts.

Kéire 0.3.1 is a pre-1.0 release. These are implemented workflows, while the production-readiness review documents remaining gates.

01

Scene and prefab authoring

Typed components, hierarchy operations, nested prefab overrides, transactional edits, recovery state, and deterministic serialization.

02

Shader and Material Graphs

Custom shader graphs expose a deliberate interface to material graphs, direct materials, and lightweight inherited instances.

03

GPU VFX and diagnostics

Context-aware authoring, event flows, live preview, profiling, capability validation, and last-good generated programs.

04

C# gameplay assemblies

Managed behaviors, reload generations, editor/runtime assembly boundaries, exposed fields, and build-time API validation.

Read the architecture and release gates.
